review_candidates.title: Linux System Administrator - Remote Work
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Linux System Administrator at BairesDev As a Linux System Administrator at BairesDev, you will be responsible for managing, maintaining, and optimizing Linux-based infrastructure. What You'll Do: - Design, implement, and maintain Linux-based server infrastructures and cloud environments. - Configure and manage Linux systems, including system monitoring, performance tuning, and troubleshooting. - Automate system administration tasks using configuration management tools and scripting. What We Are
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: What We Are Looking For: - 3+ years of experience in Linux system administration. - Strong expertise in Linux system configuration, management, and troubleshooting. - Proficiency in shell scripting and automation tools (Ansible, Puppet, Chef).
